propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, while all other store write paths inherit self-healing transient-fault retry through gitutil.run_git_write
Three CI test failures show identical signature 'could not bundle merged tip <sha> for ref tickets: fatal: bad object HEAD', indicating a transient missing object in git ODB at bundle time
The mechanism reproduces by making the merge commit's loose object unreadable immediately before the bundle call, proving object absence not corruption
s3_doctor._git must route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit per-store advisory git-op lock and bounded retry on transient read faults
The 'bad object' signature must be added to gitutil's transient marker family so the proven missing-object fault self-heals without growing a fourth private retry loop
